2609.29912.title: Structured Pose-Conditioned Flow Matching for Generative 5G CSI Augmentation
2609.29912.paper_summary: With the growing demand for privacy-preserving and occlusion-resilient human pose recognition (HPR), 5G channel state information (CSI) offers a promising contactless sensing modality by integrating communication and sensing capabilities. However, collecting large-scale synchronized CSI-pose pairs remains costly in practical 5G systems. To address this limitation, we propose StructFlow-HPR, a structured pose-conditioned flow matching framework for generative CSI augmentation. StructFlow-HPR learns a continuous latent transport process from Gaussian noise to real CSI representations under pose guidance, while preserving the receiver-frequency topology of CSI through a reconstruction-preserving autoencoder. A pose-conditioned Transformer is further designed to model the latent velocity field and generate pose-aligned CSI samples via ordinary differential equation sampling. Experiments on real-world 5G sensing data show that StructFlow-HPR can produce realistic CSI-pose pairs and improve downstream HPR performance under limited-data conditions.
2609.29912.paper_summary_zh: 隨著對隱私保護和遮蔽抗干擾的人體姿勢識別（HPR）的需求日益增長，5G通道狀態信息（CSI）通過整合通信和感測能力，提供了一種有前景的無接觸感測模式。<lb/>然而，在實際的5G系統中，收集大規模同步的CSI-姿勢對仍然成本高昂。<lb/>為了解決這一限制，我們提出了StructFlow-HPR，一種結構化的姿勢條件流匹配框架，用於生成CSI增強。<lb/>StructFlow-HPR在姿勢指導下，從高斯噪聲學習連續的潛在傳輸過程到真實的CSI表示，同時通過重建保留自編碼器保持CSI的接收器頻率拓撲。<lb/>進一步設計了一個姿勢條件的Transformer來建模潛在速度場，並通過常微分方程取樣生成姿勢對齊的CSI樣本。<lb/>在真實世界的5G感測數據上的實驗表明，StructFlow-HPR可以生成真實的CSI-姿勢對，並在有限數據條件下提高下游HPR性能。
